sourceIntent.intent: Reference vehicle suppression resolves a first surface before its friendly-proximity check. Its delayed useWeapon and unleased watch writes are not imported.

finding: Existing loaded-ammo blast veto checked intended aimpoint only. Protected person beside a nearer wall could be outside the firing cone and far from target while near a possible explosive impact.
implementation: Shared CortexLineOfFireClear keeps the intended aimpoint and adds the first FIRE/GEOM surface to blast exclusions. At most one ray only for loaded damaging explosive ammo. Existing single corridor query/64-candidate bound and ordinary bullet path retained. No native fire order or building-destruction permission added.
limits: Straight-line surface is not actual ballistic impact, penetration, hull or future-motion proof.
Actual combined-arms destructive building fire remains a separate unimplemented intent; current direct object fire is not proof of that feature.
One added ray per explosive safety call needs physical overhead/balance verification.
